ResearchTabDef.label: Wellspring
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Wells, irrigation, cisterns, and the waterworks that keep a colony supplied.

ResearchProjectDef.label: wellcraft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Digging and lining wells, coopering rain barrels, and building cisterns: the craft of finding water and keeping it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: irrigation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Trenching drawn water into cropland to work it into rich, dark irrigated soil that grows anything faster.

ResearchProjectDef.label: waterworks
ResearchProjectDef.description: Deeper shafts, taller tanks: reinforced deep wells that tap the water table and elevated towers that stockpile serious reserves.
